text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On one of my days off, I drop by the park, and…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? My name? It's Haru Urara!

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara? Oh my. Do you by chance study at Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For some reason, Haru Urara is having a picnic with a random family.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You're a Tracen Academy student?! Incredible!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, it's you, Trainer! Wanna have lunch with us?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara sees that I'm here and invites me to the picnic.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ahhh… That was so tasty! Thank you for the meal!

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text: Please, don't mention it! It's my thanks for playing with my son.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh, that reminds me! We've done seven rounds of guessing which way the other is going to look, but we haven't settled our score yet!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: You promised to do the last round after we ate! But you better be ready for me to win!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah right! There's no way I'm gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm the best at rock-paper-scissors AND at turning my head really fast!

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text: Awww… They're just like brother and sister!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems that her bright and bubbly personality makes everyone want to be her friend.
